name: fix-chat-session-scroll
title: Fix chat scroll jump on session enter
description: When entering/switching a chat session, the message list visibly scrolls from top to bottom. Root cause: ChatPanel scrolls to bottom with smooth behavior on sessionId change, and messages are replaced in one batch, so the smooth animation traverses the whole list. Fix: use instant jump (behavior auto / direct scrollTop) for session switches, keep smooth only for streaming updates.
creator: Maplume
